title: Leading Indian Tech Companies Q2FY27 Results and Global Market Dynamics
summary: Leading Indian tech companies reported strong Q2FY27 results, with RBL Bank reporting a 2.7-fold increase in net profit to ₹482 crore and HCLTech reporting a 21.2% profit rise to ₹5,132 crore, driven by strong interest income growth and positive global economic conditions. India stocks faced a 'heavy lift' due to global uncertainty and energy prices, with the Nifty 50 earnings rising 24.7% in Q2FY27. This reflects positive global economic conditions.

facts.statement: RBL Bank reported a 2.7-fold increase in net profit to ₹482 crore in Q2FY27.
HCLTech reported a 21.2% profit rise to ₹5,132 crore in Q2FY27.
India stocks faced a 'heavy lift' due to global uncertainty and energy prices.

sources.title: Black Box Q2 profit rises 30.6% to ₹72.6 crore; revenue up 22.2%
sources.description:
Essar Group's IT firm Black Box on Friday reported a 30.6 per cent increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 72.68 crore for the July-September quarter of FY27, aided by growth in data centre and enterprise businesses.
The Mumbai-headquartered company had posted a net profit of Rs 55.65 crore in the year-ago period, according to a regulatory filing by the company.
Black Box's revenue from operations rose 22.2 per cent to Rs 1,936.30 crore, up from Rs 1,584.59 crore in Q2 FY26.
Sequentially, the profit and revenue rose 30 per cent and 13 per cent, respectively.
Growth was driven by execution across hyperscale data centre infrastructure and enterprise solutions, supported by growing momentum in its technology products business, the company said in a statement.
Black Box secured over USD 250 million in data centre orders in the first half of FY27. A substantial pipeline of large hyperscale deals is expected to drive significant order wins and accelerate growth in the coming quarters,

sources.title: ABB India Q3CY26 results: Net profit rises 11% to ₹440 cr, revenue up 19.4%
sources.description:
Electrification and automation major ABB India on Friday posted an 11 per cent rise in net profit to Rs 440 crore in the September quarter compared to the year-ago period, driven by higher revenues.
The company follows a January-December fiscal year.
The net profit was Rs 398 crore in the quarter ended on September 30, 2025, an exchange filing showed.
Revenues from operations rose to Rs 3,738 crore in the quarter from Rs 3,130 crore in the same period a year ago.
ABB India Managing Director Sanjeev Sharma said, "We delivered a strong third quarter, with record Q3 orders, revenue growth and a healthy backlog reflecting continued customer confidence in ABB's technology and solutions."
He stated that the demand remained broad-based across industries, supported by investments in productivity, energy efficiency and sustainable growth.
Looking ahead, he stated that India's structural growth drivers in industrialisation, electrification, digitalisation and the energy transition continue

sources.title: Edelweiss Financial Services Q2 FY27 results: Profit rises 18% to ₹207 cr
sources.description:
Edelweiss Financial Services on Friday reported an 18 per cent growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 207 crore for the second quarter ended September.
The company had earned a profit of Rs 175 crore in the corresponding quarter of the preceding fiscal.
Total income increased to Rs 2,602 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared to Rs 1,900 crore in the year-ago period, Edelweiss Financial Services said in a regulatory filing.
Interest income rose to Rs 720 crore from Rs 687 crore in the same quarter a year ago.
During the quarter, total expenses also rose to Rs 2,393 crore from Rs 1,946 crore in the same period a year ago.
The company completed the Rs 1,200-crore IPO of its subsidiary Edelweiss Alternatives last month.
Earlier this year, global investment management firm Carlyle became a strategic majority investor in another subsidiary of the company, Nido Home Finance, with an investment of Rs 2,000 crore.

sources.title: Natco Pharma Q2 results: Net profit declines 60.8% to ₹202.6 crore
sources.description:
Natco Pharma on Friday posted a 60.8 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 202.6 crore during the September quarter, weighed down by a fall in revenues.
The pharma company had reported a net profit of Rs 517.9 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding fiscal.
Its revenue from operations declined to Rs 967.3 crore in the second quarter of FY27 from Rs 1,363 crore a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Total expenses stood at Rs 776.2 crore, down from Rs 849.3 crore a year ago, it said.
During the quarter, Natco acquired an additional 13.25 per cent stake in Adcock Ingram Holding Ltd.
In the first half of the current fiscal (H1 FY27), Natco Pharma posted a 59 per cent decline in net profit to Rs 409.1 crore from Rs 998.2 crore in the April-September period of the preceding financial year.
The company's board of directors also approved an interim dividend of Rs 1.25 per equity share of Rs 2 each during the quarter under review.
